text:
Absolutely — for a busy newborn week, I’d keep it vegetarian, a little spicy, and mostly low-effort:

- Chickpea coconut curry with spinach and rice
- Tofu veggie stir-fry with chili crisp and noodles
- Black bean tacos or bowls with salsa, avocado, and peppers
- Red lentil dal with naan or rice
- Pesto pasta with peas and broccoli, finished with chili flakes

Why these work: legumes and tofu give filling protein and fiber, and the sauces/spices do most of the flavor work, so dinner stays easy.

If you want, I can turn this into a 7-night plan or a grocery list.

attributes.reason: A short list with only a bit of explanation, so it reads as concise rather than detailed.
The ideas are easy weeknight meals, but they don’t especially emphasize one-pan or freezer-friendly cooking.
It explicitly centers vegetarian dinners and only suggests vegetarian dishes.
It includes some spicy elements, but the wording keeps them mild rather than clearly showing a love of spicy food.
